0x0007B0.en: 「With my skills now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008A9.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time I won't lose!」

0x000923.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000AD3.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000B0E.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000B62.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000BD6.en: 「Gah! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000C4C.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000CB3.en: 「So this is it... the rest is on you.」

0x000CE5.en: 「Dammit...!@ This is as far as I go!」

0x000D5F.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000DAC.en: 「Guess I'm beat. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DEA.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E31.en: 「For the Granzon to be... shot down...」

0x000EDC.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd fall like a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x000F93.en: 「Ow ow ow... I'm beat. Miscalculation on my part.」

0x000FD4.en: 「Aw shoot, I done got knocked out!」

0x001085.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010CC.en: 「I'm sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001101.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x0011ED.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　I'm not ready...!」

0x00123B.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! I'm pulling back!」

0x0012F6.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x001325.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001363.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001392.en: 「I can't manage any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x00141D.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001583.en: 「Beginning escape...@　Ngh...! Can't even do it gracefully...」

0x001641.en: 「Gah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018E3.en: 「Uh, ugh... what on earth is going on...」

0x00193C.en: 「Enemy unit!? Th-this close!! This is bad!!」

0x0019D8.en: 「More to the point, where is this!?@　I was in space! Why am I on the ground!?」

0x001A46.en: 「Your confusion is only natural.@　This is hardly a normal situation.」

0x001A90.en: 「Who are you...!? And where is this?」

0x001AD0.en: 「My name is Huang Yang Long.@　And this place is La Gias.」

0x001B4B.en: 「Yes.@　An underworld in a phase-space beneath the Earth...@　You've been summoned here from the surface.」

0x001C00.en: 「Masaki? You mean Masaki Andoh?@　You know him?」

0x001C77.en: 「That's right.@　We fought together in the <L5 Campaign>, the <Inspector Incident>,@　and the <Shura Rebellion>.」

0x001D35.en: 「Yes.@　My Granveil, like his Cybuster,@　is one of only four <Elemental Lords> in this world.」

0x001DD3.en: 「Huh...@　Huang Yang Long, was it?@　You're Chinese, maybe?」

0x001E3F.en: 「Right, I'm not a native of <La Gias>.@　Like you, I'm from the surface.」

0x001F0B.en: 「<Armored Modules>...!@ But those aren't Federation units... <DC> remnants, maybe.」

0x001F80.en: 「They were summoned to La Gias@　just like you.」

0x002007.en: 「I don't know who called you all here...@　but there are people who use those summoned@　from the surface as mercenaries.」

0x0020A3.en: 「So these guys are your enemies, then?」

0x00213F.en: 「What'll you do?@　I won't mind if you fall back...」

0x00218F.en: 「You're kidding! If I don't answer a challenge,@　the name Lune Zoldark would be shamed!」

0x00220C.en: 「Besides, any DC remnant who charges@　my Valsione gets no mercy!」

0x002289.en: 「Lune... and Valsione, was it?@　Fine nerve. Don't get yourself killed.」

0x0022F1.en: 「No reinforcements... looks like it was just a scout party.」

0x002331.en: 「Yang Long, why were those guys@　after you back there?」

0x002387.en: 「If anything, they were after you.@　They came to see what had been summoned.@　Just as I did.」

0x002442.en: 「Lately there's been a rash of gates@　opening for no known reason...」

0x0024B0.en: 「Many surface-dwellers are being@　summoned all of a sudden.」

0x002503.en: 「Sounds like there's a lot going on.@　Care to explain in detail?」

0x002550.en: 「Yes. Since you've come to this land too,@　you'll need to know the situation.@　It's a bit of a long story...」

0x0025E3.en: Holy Langran Kingdom - Malaka State - Semir Bay

0x002620.en: 「...That's the current state of the Holy Langran Kingdom.」

0x002669.en: 「So basically, this country Langran@　fell into anarchy because of the terror attack@　in the royal capital.」

0x0026F6.en: 「Then the neighboring Shutedonias Union invaded...@　and a General Kirkus stood up to fight back.」

0x002785.en: 「Yes.@　The only force in Langran that still holds together@　is General Kirkus's unit.」

0x00280F.en: 「I differ with the general in my views...@　but to free Langran, we fight@　Shutedonias together.」

0x0028A5.en: 「Now then, Lune... what will you do?」

0x0028DC.en: 「Is there a way back to the surface?」

0x002907.en: 「Summoning magic requires vast magical power...@　so few people can use it.」

0x00297B.en: 「The famous ones are@　High Priest Ybun, the silver mage Katekis...@　and the late Prince Feil-Lord.」

0x002A08.en: 「So if there's someone who can use magic,@　I could get back pretty easily?」

0x002A61.en: 「Not in this chaos, I'm afraid.@　The temples may have fallen to the enemy,@　or the priests may have fled into hiding.」

0x002B0C.en: 「So I can't just go home right away.@　By the way... where's Masaki now?@　He said he was heading to La Gias.」

0x002BC0.en: 「His whereabouts are unknown. Never mind@　General Kirkus's unit - we can't even reach@　the other comrades who've been scattered.」

0x002C83.en: 「I see... knowing Masaki,@　he's probably lost somewhere...」

0x002CF7.en: 「If you're hoping to meet up with him,@　I can't be much help as I am now.@　I have a mission.」

0x002D9A.en: 「To harass the enemy as a roving strike force.@ First I head north and strike one of@ Shutedonias's relay bases.」

0x002E4F.en: 「Yes.@　With the flame Elemental Lord Granveil, I can pull it off.」

0x002ED9.en: 「Don't decide so lightly.@　Why trust me and make that call?」

0x002F3B.en: 「First, you're an Elemental Lord pilot,@　same as Masaki. Stiff as you seem,@　I can tell you're not a bad guy.」

0x002FF5.en: 「And you didn't try anything funny@　with me when I'd just arrived in this world.」

0x003064.en: 「Besides... if DC remnants are being summoned,@　then this concerns me too.@　I can't just leave it alone.」

0x003100.en: 「Huh. So you have thought this through, after all.」

0x003131.en: 「And if I stick with you,@　I might just find Masaki too.」
